name: Morino Minato
source:
[i]A cheerful and caring childhood friend of the protagonist who is passionate about cheerleading.[/i]

A second-year female student at Tatsuryou Academy, she is a member of the cheerleading club.

Ryo's classmate and childhood friend.

She has a bright and active personality, and loves to take care of people, often taking on the less fortunates' burdens herself.

She talks casually to Ryo, who tends to be isolated in class, but Ryo seems to be annoyed by this.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/medorei/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
